# Scageon Website — Build Plan

**Type:** Company marketing website (IT / software services)
**Stack:** Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + React Bits
**Direction:** Light & clean, modern, professional, with deliberate scroll motion
**Sections:** Home · About Us · Services · Industries · Contact Us
**Design source of truth:** [`design-system/scageon/MASTER.md`](design-system/scageon/MASTER.md) (generated by the `ui-ux-pro-max` skill)

> This plan is the *how*. `MASTER.md` is the *what* (tokens, component specs, anti-patterns).
> Per-page tweaks live in `design-system/scageon/pages/[page].md` and override MASTER.

## 2. Design system — derived from the Scageon brand deck

**Aesthetic (confirmed): Hybrid** — light/clean content on white/off-white, with **dark navy hero, nav, and footer bands** that host the white logo. Premium AI-lab feel + clean readability.

**Brand tokens (from the company profile deck — replaces the generic DB placeholders):**

| Role | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Ink / dark surface | `#0A1620` | Hero, nav, footer bands; white logo lives here |
| Dark surface 2 | `#12232F` | Dark cards / raised panels on dark bands |
| Background (light) | `#F6F8FA` | Main content background |
| Surface (light) | `#FFFFFF` | Cards on light |
| Text on light | `#0E1A24` | Body/headings on light |
| Accent — azure | `#1CA0E6` | Primary CTA, links, glow (the case-card cyan) |
| Secondary — violet | `#8E7DE3` | Secondary accent (healthcare/AI motif) |
| Muted text | `#5A6B78` | Captions, secondary copy |
| Border (light) | `#E2E8EC` | Dividers, card borders |

**Typography (echoes the deck: geometric logo + serif tagline + clean body):**
- **Display (serif):** Fraunces *(or Newsreader)* — matches the deck's refined serif tagline; premium, editorial
- **Body / UI (sans):** Manrope *(or Inter)* — geometric, echoes the logo's monoline geometry
- **Eyebrows / labels / data:** Space Grotesk, uppercase + wide tracking — nods to the geometric logo

**Style / pattern:** Swiss Modernism 2.0 (12-col grid, mathematical spacing) · Enterprise Gateway pattern (hero → services → industries → proof → contact).

**Signature element:** the logo's **aperture "O" (circle with a centered dot)** + the deck's **network/constellation graph** → a recurring animated **node-network motif**. Used as: hero ambient background, section eyebrow glyph (`⊙`), and a scroll-revealed constellation. Distinctive to Scageon, not a template default.

**Motion tier:** Standard — scroll reveals + staggered entrances, 300–600ms.
**Hard anti-patterns:** excessive animation · emoji icons · low-contrast text · layout-shifting hovers.

> Next: fold these tokens into `design-system/scageon/MASTER.md` and `lib/tokens.css` at Phase 1.
> Full content model in [`CONTENT-ARCHITECTURE.md`](CONTENT-ARCHITECTURE.md).

## 3. Tech stack & project structure

```
website/
├─ app/
│  ├─ layout.tsx            # fonts, nav, footer, smooth-scroll + route-transition overlay
│  ├─ page.tsx              # Home
│  ├─ about/page.tsx
│  ├─ services/page.tsx + services/[slug]/page.tsx   # 3 detail pages
│  ├─ industries/page.tsx + industries/[slug]/page.tsx # 5 detail pages
│  └─ contact/page.tsx
├─ content/                # copy as data: services.ts, industries.ts, caseStudies.ts
├─ components/
│  ├─ reactbits/            # React Bits components (added via CLI, per-component)
│  ├─ sections/             # Hero, ServicesGrid, IndustryCards, AboutStats, ContactForm…
│  ├─ layout/               # Navbar, Footer, TransitionOverlay
│  └─ ui/                   # shadcn/ui primitives
├─ lib/
│  ├─ tokens.css            # brand tokens (mirrors MASTER.md)
│  └─ motion.ts             # shared Framer Motion variants / GSAP helpers
├─ public/brand/            # logo, favicon, OG image
└─ design-system/scageon/   # MASTER.md + pages/ overrides
```

**Key dependencies:** `next`, `tailwindcss`, `framer-motion` (or `gsap` + `ScrollTrigger`), `lenis` (smooth scroll), `lucide-react` (icons), `@radix-ui/*` via shadcn.

**React Bits install:** components are added per-item via the React Bits CLI (source is copied into `components/reactbits/`), not installed as one npm package. We pull only what each section needs — keeps the bundle lean.

## 4. Section-by-section plan + React Bits mapping

Each section: its single job, the copy it needs from you, its React Bits component(s), and its scroll behavior. **Rule from the skill: max 1–2 animated elements per view.**

### Home (`/`)
- **Job:** State what Scageon does in one line; route visitors to Services/Contact.
- **Needs from you:** one-line value prop, 3–4 headline stats, client logos (optional).
- **React Bits:** `SplitText`/`BlurText` (headline), one ambient background — `Aurora`/`Silk`/`Threads` (subtle, behind hero), `ShinyText` (CTA), `CountUp` (stats).
- **Motion:** headline splits/fades on load; stats count up on scroll-into-view; section reveals on enter.

### About Us (`/about`)
- **Job:** Build trust — who we are, mission, what makes us different, team/stats.
- **Needs:** short company story, mission statement, 3–4 differentiators, team members (optional).
- **React Bits:** `ScrollReveal` (paragraph reveal), `TiltedCard` or `ProfileCard` (team), `CountUp` (years/projects/clients).
- **Motion:** staggered reveal of value points; subtle parallax on a background layer only.

### Services (`/services`)
- **Job:** Present core offerings clearly; each links to detail or contact.
- **Needs:** list of services + a one-liner and icon each.
- **React Bits:** `SpotlightCard` or `MagicBento` grid; `AnimatedList` for feature bullets.
- **Motion:** staggered card entrance (30–50ms per card); spotlight/tilt on hover.

### Industries (`/industries`)
- **Job:** Show the verticals Scageon serves.
- **Needs:** list of industries + short blurb + icon each.
- **React Bits:** `Carousel` or `TiltedCard` grid; `Magnet` on interactive chips.
- **Motion:** horizontal/staggered reveal; hover lift (no layout shift).

### Contact Us (`/contact`)
- **Job:** Make it effortless to reach Scageon.
- **Needs:** email, phone, address, form fields, social links; where submissions go (email? form service?).
- **React Bits:** `StarBorder` (submit button), `ClickSpark` (feedback).
- **Motion:** field focus micro-interactions; inline validation on blur; success state on submit.

### Global (nav + footer)
- **React Bits:** `GooeyNav` or `Dock` (nav), `Magnet` (links).
- **Motion:** sticky navbar shrinks/gains shadow on scroll; active-route highlight; route-change transition overlay (from MASTER.md motion spec).

## 4b. Interconnection & guided flow (your key requirement)

**Principle:** every page is a doorway to the next. Nothing is a dead end — the whole site is one connected graph, and the home page *leads* the visitor through it.

### The link graph (everything connects to everything)

```
                    ┌──────────────┐
                    │     HOME      │  guided scroll flow
                    └──────┬───────┘
        ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐
        ▼                  ▼                  ▼
  ┌──────────┐      ┌────────────┐      ┌──────────┐
  │ SERVICES │◄────►│ CASE STUDY │◄────►│INDUSTRIES│
  └────┬─────┘      │  (proof)   │      └────┬─────┘
       │            └────────────┘           │
       │   service ▸ "applied in" ▸ industry │
       │   industry ▸ "powered by" ▸ service │
       └───────────────┬────────────────────┘
                       ▼
                  ┌──────────┐
                  │ CONTACT  │  reachable from every section
                  └──────────┘
```

**Concrete cross-links:**
- Home service card → `/services/[slug]`; Home industry card → `/industries/[slug]`
- **Service detail** page ends with *"Industries we apply this in"* → links to each `/industries/[slug]`
- **Industry detail** page ends with *"Services powering this"* → links to each `/services/[slug]`
- Every case study links to **both** its industry and its service
- Persistent **Contact** CTA at the end of every section/page
- Mega-menus in the nav expose all 3 services + 5 industries from anywhere

### Home as a guided flow

The home page is a **scroll-driven narrative** that "takes" the visitor through Scageon's story, chapter by chapter:

1. **Hook** — "Enabling an AI-Powered Future" (dark hero)
2. **What we do** — the 3 services surface as you scroll → each clickable into its page
3. **Where we do it** — the 5 industries → each clickable into its page
4. **Proof** — case-study impact tiles animate in
5. **Invitation** — Contact

**Signature tie-in:** a **connecting thread** (an SVG line echoing the node-network motif) *draws itself as you scroll*, visually linking each chapter — literally showing "connected data & AI." Built with GSAP ScrollTrigger `scrub` on an SVG path; nodes light up (the aperture "⊙" glyph) as each section enters. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (thread appears static).

**React Bits for the flow:** `ScrollReveal` per chapter, `AnimatedContent`/stagger for cards, `Magnet` on the flow's CTAs, `CountUp` on proof tiles. Kept to 1–2 animated elements per view.

## 5. Motion & scroll strategy (validated against the skill)

Pulled from `--domain gsap`, Standard tier:

- **Scroll reveal:** `opacity 0→1, y 12→0`, 300–400ms, `power1.out`, trigger `top 90%`. Small offset = reads as a fade, not a slide.
- **Stagger:** headline chars via `SplitText` (or React Bits `SplitText`), 15ms stagger, `expo.out`. Headlines only — never long paragraphs.
- **Parallax:** background/decorative layers only, `yPercent 5–15`, `scrub`. Never on text or controls.
- **Page transition:** overlay `yPercent` at layout root, 400–600ms, `power2.inOut`.
- **Smooth scroll:** Lenis for the whole page.

**Non-negotiables (skill anti-patterns):**
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables/reduces all of the above.
- Animate `transform`/`opacity` only (never width/height/top/left) → no CLS.
- SEO content must not be invisible-by-default without a no-JS fallback.
- One ambient background max; resist decorative motion everywhere.

## 7. Pre-delivery checklist (from the skill)

- [ ] No emojis as icons (SVG only — Lucide/Heroicons)
- [ ] `cursor-pointer` on all clickable elements
- [ ] Hover states transition in 150–300ms
- [ ] Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (light mode)
- [ ] Visible keyboard focus states
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Responsive at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px
- [ ] No content hidden behind the fixed navbar
- [ ] No horizontal scroll on mobile
